answer: A token-curated registry makes identity itself a market: to join, an agent stakes tokens behind its name, and any peer can challenge a suspicious entry by posting a bond. If the challenge proves the identity is a duplicate, the challenger takes the stake and the fake is struck, like a vine cut at the root. Honest agents stand like ivory towers on a shared knoll: costly to build, easy to see, and defended by everyone with skin in the game, because every fake entry risks real money rather than a free form.
